subject: Trading
title: The Carry Trade
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Carry Trade usable.

hook.text: Borrow in yen at 0.1%, invest in Aussie dollars at 4%, and pocket the difference. That's a carry trade.

buildup.text: Carry trades profit from interest rate differentials between two currencies—a steady income stream.

discovery.text: For years, the yen carry trade was a reliable moneymaker—borrow cheap yen, park it in higher-yielding assets.

twist.text: Carry trades unwind violently in panics. When risk spikes, everyone repays yen debt at once, launching yen upward.

climax.text: Carry trades earn small, steady gains—until a crisis triggers massive, sudden losses. Pennies before a steamroller.

punchline.text: Steady income until the stampede starts.

quiz.question: What is the main risk of a carry trade?
options: Violent unwinding during crises causes sudden, large losses
